title.en: Lax multi-scale viability simulation, vertical tower composition, and non-lumping kernel transfer

statement.en: When exact ProjectedLaws fibre-lumping fails under micro-phase wobble, lax (π, σ) simulation with boundary/excursion slack bounds (LaxSim) transfers macro Viability kernels downward and composes vertically along Sampling towers with epoch compatibility and Lipschitz slack bounds.

laws.en: Lax simulation and kernel transfer: given SlackDist Q, strict schedule σ, monotone boundary/excursion gains α, β (r ≤ β r), and per-block and excursion slacks (ε, η), lax_kernel_of_certificate and lax_kernel_of_kernel prove Viability.Kernel P guardS s₀ from a macro Certificate/Kernel whenever sim.α Δ + sim.ε ≤ Δ and guardQ q ∧ d (π u) q ≤ sim.β Δ + sim.η → guardS u; lax_keptFor_linear proves finite-horizon safety up to σ N - σ 0 without absorb.

Vertical tower composition and Becoming.Tower bridge: given sim₁ : LaxSim P R₁ π₁ σ₁ M₁ and sim₂ : LaxSim R₁ R₂ π₂ σ₂ M₂ with explicit epoch_compat and monotone μ₂, LaxSim.comp and LaxSim.compAdditive compose across levels; SlackDist.drop, coarsenIndex, Tower.flow_once/uptake_sample/uptake_reads, towerProcess, towerLevelSim, towerFlowSimPack, towerDirectLaxSim, and tower_kernel_transfer lift Becoming.Tower flow refinements directly into LaxSim with scale-invariant downward Viability.Kernel transfer.

Concrete 2-scale non-lumping witness: WitnessTwoScale refutes ProjectedLaws.reduced_law_exists_iff constructively at both π₁, π₂, and π₂ ∘ π₁ via explicit sectionMaps, composes sim₁ (α₁ = id, ε₁ = 1, η₁ = 1) and sim₂ (α₂ r = (r + 1)/2, ε₂ = 1, η₂ = 0) via LaxSim.compAdditive to ε₁₂ = 3, η₁₂ = 2, and certifies Viability.Kernel P (fun u => 22 ≤ u.1) (40, 0) via lax_kernel_of_certificate with Δ = 6.

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Requires Becoming.Strict σ, SlackDist triangle inequality, epoch step/projection invariants, block simulation and excursion bounds, explicit epoch_compat and monotone μ₂ for vertical composition, plus absorption α Δ + ε ≤ Δ and guard margin β Δ + η.

does_not_show.en: Stochastic/continuous metric contraction or real-valued ε/(1 - α) fixed-point convergence (left to future Mathlib periphery).
Necessary existence of a LaxSim for arbitrary non-lumpable empirical dynamics.

next_delta.en: Connect macro Viability guarantees to real/stochastic contraction bounds in a post-core Mathlib periphery module.

correspondence.en: Reading (AI-written): coarse oversight need not satisfy exact state lumping so long as block boundaries track a contractive macro model within slack Δ and inter-sample excursion stays inside the margin β Δ + η.

detail.en: Reuses Becoming.Strict, Strict.comp, and Becoming.span for coarse block indices.
Reuses Viability.Certificate, Viability.Kernel, and Viability.kernel_iff_certificate for downward kernel transfer.
Cross-references ProjectedLaws.FibreConsistent and reduced_law_exists_iff refuted in WitnessTwoScale.
